objective: Test whether the load-bearing WIDTH_CAPMASK_OWNER_DEPTH_HISTOGRAMS OOO triple motifs factor through mechanically defined exchange/circuit geometry of their three structured vertices, preserving genuinely triadic relations while discarding some absolute vertex identity.

vertexVectorEmbedding.width: one integer coordinate W equal to component width
vertexVectorEmbedding.capacity: one binary count coordinate C_i for each canonical local role i with cap_i=1; width determines the role range
vertexVectorEmbedding.owner0Depth: integer count coordinate D0_d for every relative depth d
vertexVectorEmbedding.owner1Depth: integer count coordinate D1_d for every relative depth d
vertexVectorEmbedding.exactness: This token-count vector exactly represents the frozen selected motif vertex identity.

pairExchange.orientation: For an unordered vertex pair, order endpoints by the frozen vertex-identity string and compute target-minus-source on every token-count coordinate.
pairExchange.exactDelta: Sparse sorted signed integer difference vector.
pairExchange.normProfile: (|delta W|, capacity Hamming distance, owner0 depth-histogram L1 distance, owner1 depth-histogram L1 distance).

candidates.name: EXCHANGE_NORM_TRIANGLE
candidates.definition: Sorted multiset of the three pair norm profiles.

candidates.name: EXCHANGE_EXACT_DELTA_TRIANGLE
candidates.definition: Sorted multiset of the three exact signed pair-delta signatures.

candidates.name: BASEFREE_TWO_LEG_EXCHANGE
candidates.definition: Choose the lexicographically smallest frozen vertex as base; encode the sorted exact deltas from that base to the other two vertices, omitting the base identity itself.

candidates.name: BASEFREE_PLUS_BASE_WIDTH_CAP
candidates.definition: BASEFREE_TWO_LEG_EXCHANGE plus the base vertex's exact width and capacity-parity mask.

candidates.name: BASEFREE_PLUS_BASE_WIDTH_CAP_OWNER_TOTALS
candidates.definition: Previous candidate plus base owner-separated total residual-cell counts, but not their depth distribution.

candidates.name: BASEFREE_PLUS_BASE_WIDTH_CAP_OWNER_DEPTH_PARITY
candidates.definition: Previous width/cap base data plus owner-separated parity histograms of residual-cell depths (counts mod 2 at each depth).

candidates.name: BASEFREE_PLUS_BASE_FULL_VERTEX
candidates.definition: BASEFREE_TWO_LEG_EXCHANGE plus the complete frozen selected motif base vertex; reconstruction control.

candidates.name: FULL_TRIPLE_MOTIF
candidates.definition: Complete unordered selected triple-motif identity; EW-RS-067/068 reconstruction control.

structuralProcedure: Inherit EW-RS-065 matched degree<=2 dependencies and OOO residues unchanged.
Map exact descriptor IDs to the frozen EW-RS-067 selected motif vertex identity without outcomes.
Compute every triple's exchange/circuit candidate key before scalar replay.
Map each matched dependency to GF(2) parity of candidate keys and freeze a deterministic structural basis.
Only after each structural candidate map is frozen replay the two-bit scalar residues.
measurements: candidate image rank on the selected triple-motif dependency image
kernel dimension relative to selected triple-motif rank
scalar image dimension on a structurally selected candidate basis
antiCircularity: The vertex vector embedding, pair orientation, exchange definitions, candidate family, and selection order are frozen before scalar inspection.
No pair delta, norm, base feature, candidate key, or exception is selected using W/D/L.
All candidates are deterministic functions of the frozen selected motif vertex strings.
The matched dependency carrier is inherited unchanged from EW-RS-065.
EW-RS-059 PRIMARY 3x6-k4 and BACKUP 5x3-k4 remain sealed.
falsifiers: BASEFREE_PLUS_BASE_FULL_VERTEX and FULL_TRIPLE_MOTIF must reproduce exact EW-RS-067 scalar factorization and selected motif ranks 75,288,16.
Any candidate with structurally zero residue but nonzero scalar residue is insufficient.
A candidate is selected only if it has zero scalar contradictions on all three declared carriers.
No post-hoc scalar-driven refinement is allowed.
nextIfExchangePasses: Freeze the coarsest common passing exchange/circuit invariant and reduce its scalar image outcome-independently before selecting any closed syndrome coefficients.
nextIfOnlyReconstructionPasses: Record that base-free exchange geometry is insufficient under the declared embedding and move to mechanically generated oriented/circuit incidence invariants on full selected triple motifs.
interpretationGuards: A passing exchange signature is a bounded structural scalar factorization, not yet a universal closed formula.
Failure does not exclude other circuit/orientation constructions outside this frozen ladder.
No Q-A/Q-F, standard-7x6, universal theorem, or center-opening proof follows.
